card.name: Small words in web page footers
card.fires_on: Small linking words (about, of, the, same, in, has) inside stock web-page or documentation text such as man-page colophons, citation titles, and site notices.

modes.label: Man-page colophon
modes.description: Linking words inside the standard Linux man-pages project closing note.
modes.example: COLOPHON This page is part of release 3.27 of the Linux man-pages project. A description of the project, and information<< about>> reporting bugs, can be found at http

modes.label: Reference and title text
modes.description: Small words inside bibliography entries or titles of technical documentation.
modes.example: McKusick, V.A. (1994). Mendelian Inheritance in Man. Catalogs<< of>> Human Genes and Genetic Disorders.

modes.label: Site notices and guides
modes.description: Linking words in programming guides, accessibility guidelines or article maintenance banners.
